proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our bungalow still has the original white hex floor, but a plumber had smashed a patch the size of a pizza box. Halina found matching old hex and you honestly cannot find the repair now.
reviews.name: Bernadette Z.

reviews.text: They talked us out of tearing out the 1926 tile on the walls. Regrouted, reset the loose pieces, and added a shower that matches. It still feels like our house.
reviews.name: Tobias N.

reviews.text: Heated floor went in during a February cold snap. Crew showed up every morning at seven, swept every night, and the floor was warm before the end of the month.
reviews.name: Ewa K.

reviews.text: Our basement floor around the drain used to crack every winter. This time they sloped it properly and used a membrane under the tile. Two winters, no cracks.
reviews.name: Rashad J.

reviews.text: The glazed green tile on our fireplace had three cracked pieces. They reset the loose ones and had two replacements made in the same green. Very patient with my questions about the history of the house.
reviews.name: Colette M.

reviews.text: Basketweave floor with a black border in the upstairs bath of our two-flat. Laid by hand, sheet by sheet, and the border meets perfectly at every corner. Tenants upstairs noticed.
reviews.name: Stanley P.

reviews.text: We needed the downstairs tub surround done between tenants. Started on a Monday, grouted by Friday, caulked and clean for showings Saturday.
reviews.name: Imelda R.

proof.guarantee: We come back and fix any tile or grout of ours that cracks or lets go for 5 years.
